implementation: Before-launch inode/link-count qualification for protected reads and admitted read/write scopes
All aliases inside the admitted scope remain usable
An exact-file grant cannot silently mutate a linked sibling
Native NUL-delimited metadata traversal without shell interpolation; cancellation, output and time bounds fail closed
limits: Qualification assumes no privileged or unsandboxed host actor changes link topology concurrently with the workload. It is not a defense against a hostile host.
Native /usr/bin/find is required on supported Unix hosts. A failed, oversized or timed-out metadata scan blocks execution.
